requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING FLAG argument is a supported flag constant
requirements.source: S17.11.56 p3 argument; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF509.
requirements.definition: FLAG shall be a scalar of type IEEE_FLAG_TYPE and its value shall be one of IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, or IEEE_INEXACT.

requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING reports halting-control support
requirements.source: S17.11.56 p5 result value; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF509.
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(FLAG) is true exactly for exceptions where the processor supports control during program execution to abort or continue after that exception; otherwise it is false.

pending.ieee_support_halting-flag-control-suppor: Guarded branch plan: for each listed flag, probe IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(flag); true branch reads IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(flag) as original, changes the mode with IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(flag,.NOT.original), reads back the changed value with IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(flag), restores original with IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(flag,original), and reads back original; no exception operation is executed while halting might be true. False branch records skip for halting-control effects.
